subject: reasoning
question:
A & B means ‘A is the wife of B’

A # B means ‘A is the sister of B’

A @ B means ‘A is the husband of B’

A % B means ‘A is the father of B’

If S & T % R @ P # Q , then how is S related to P?
solution:
**Given:**

 
 

 
 
Code

 
 
 
Meaning

 ‘A is the sister of B’

**Given code :** S & T % R @ P # Q

1) S & T means ‘S is the wife of T’.

2) T % R means ‘T is the father of R'

3) ’R @ P means ‘R is the husband of P’

4) P # Q means ‘P is the sister of Q’

The family tree looks like,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4780411abdbed532d24836648dc8f115d8d7af85be48c474a5d6d587de95c2d8.png] 

Here, S is Mother-in-law of P.

Hence,** 'Mother-in-law'** is the correct answer.
